title: Woodside Tech Investor Lists $14.9 Million French Fantasy Estate - NewsBreak
text:
By Eileen Vargas ,
6 hours ago Tucked off a quiet lane in Woodside, a once-tired villa has been reborn as a French‑inspired art de vivre compound after a four‑year restoration by tech investor Jeff Clavier and his wife, Bernadette. The 3.2‑acre property at 600 Moore Road is on the market for $14.9 million, mixing old‑world stonework with resort‑style amenities and updated infrastructure. The main stone villa is about 7,155 square feet and is joined by a two‑bedroom family cottage and a one‑bedroom guest house, for a total of seven bedrooms across the compound. Hosting perks include a temperature‑controlled wine cellar sized for roughly 3,000 bottles and a rare red‑clay tennis court set into the gardens. Read full article
